title: Declarations by Town Councils of Secretaries who Fall under New Disqualification Criteria
what_it_is: Declarations by Town Councils of Secretaries who Fall under New Disqualification Criteria

sections.label: Town Council disqualification criteria
sections.summary: Amendments effective 1 May 2017 set disqualification criteria for Town Council auditors and Managing Agent individuals; all Town Councils told MND their key appointment holders do not fall within them.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for National Development (Mr Desmond Lee) (for the Minister for National Development)
sentences.text: The amendments took effect from 1 May 2017.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for National Development (Mr Desmond Lee) (for the Minister for National Development)
sentences.text: The disqualification criteria in sections 20(1A) and 20(3) of the Act apply to an individual who is an auditor of the Town Council, or an owner, a substantial shareholder or an executive decision maker of the Town Council's Managing Agent firm.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for National Development (Mr Desmond Lee) (for the Minister for National Development)
sentences.text: In May 2017, the Ministry of National Development (MND) had requested all Town Councils to inform MND if any of their existing key appointment holders fell within the new disqualification criteria set out in the Act.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for National Development (Mr Desmond Lee) (for the Minister for National Development)
sentences.text: All Town Councils have informed MND that their key appointment holders do not fall within the new disqualification criteria.
